integrity: An all-dimension symbolic proof gives the exact Hankel rank. Executable checks independently confirm full matrix-monoid ranks in dimensions two and three, a six-by-six binary witness, and the finite monomial collision formula through dimension eight. No external scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact bound concerns GF(2)-weighted parity automata, not ordinary Boolean-semiring NFA or DFA. Three letters suffice for sharpness in every dimension at least two; binary optimality beyond dimension two and other coefficient fields are not classified. Prior-art searches are non-exhaustive.
title: Exact parity-automaton square-root state complexity \(n^3-n^2+n\)
